node.title: Averaged fiber-to-slope conversion: FM locator mean => existence of a many-SLOPE pair
node.notes: Exact occupancy proof: 1_(X_z>0)>=X_z-X_z(X_z-1)/2, summed over slopes. No cross-slope independence is used. Prize payloads must still supply paid-family ownership, overlap profile, and ambient-field scope.
node.statement: For a deterministic support family A with exact strict-overlap profile, put nu(A)=E[N(A)]-(q/2)C_t(A). For every integer B>=1, nu(A)>B-1 implies the existence of a received pair with at least B distinct finite bad slopes. Prize use with B=B*+1 therefore requires the strict certificate nu(A)>B*.
